Your files never leave your browser

Most online PDF tools upload your files to a server, process them there, and then delete them — or so they say. This site works differently: there is no server at all. Every tool runs as code inside your own browser, on your own device.

No uploads

Your PDFs are never sent anywhere. You can even turn off your internet after the page loads and the tools still work.

No accounts

No sign-up, no email, no tracking. There is nothing to log in to, and nothing stored about you.

No limits

No daily caps, no file-size paywall, no watermark on your output. Merge a hundred files if you like.

Frequently asked questions

Is it really free?

Yes. Every tool on this site is free, with no limits on the number of files or pages. The site has no server to pay for — the work happens in your browser — which is what makes it possible to keep it free.

Are my files uploaded anywhere?

No. Your files never leave your device. All processing happens locally in your browser using open-source libraries. You can verify this yourself: load a tool page, disconnect from the internet, and it still works.

Is there a file size limit?

There is no limit set by this site. The only practical limit is your device's memory — very large files (hundreds of megabytes) may be slow on older phones. For most everyday PDFs, anything works.

Does it work on phones and tablets?

Yes. The tools run in any modern browser on desktop, Android and iPhone. Large files and many pages are more comfortable on a computer, but the tools work the same way everywhere.

What about password-protected PDFs?

Password-protected PDFs cannot be edited in the browser. If your PDF asks for a password, unlock it first with your PDF reader, save an unlocked copy, and then use that copy here.

Why is there no PDF to Word tool?

Converting a PDF back into an editable Word document needs a server and heavy software to keep the layout faithful. In the browser it would produce broken tables and lost formatting, so we would rather not offer a bad version of it. The five tools here are the ones that work properly, entirely on your device.
